infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VOLYUME Pulse uses your location while you record a workout to measure distance, pace and your route. Location is only used during an activity and stays on your device.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: VOLYUME Pulse keeps workout GPS and WHOOP background sync running while your phone is pocketed or the screen is off. Location data stays on your device.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: VOLYUME Pulse connects to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read your heart rate, recovery, sleep and activity data directly from the band. Nothing leaves your device.
